name: Labour force figures, Uttar Pradesh
what: Unemployment rate, labour force participation and worker population ratio for Uttar Pradesh and All India (people aged 15+, rural and urban), every year available.
publisher: National Statistical Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
terms: Official statistics published by NSO. Client code MIT licensed. Cite MoSPI, PLFS.

name: ITIs by state
what: Number of government and private ITIs in each state, from the Ministry of Skill Development dataset on data.gov.in.
publisher: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
terms: Government Open Data License - India. Cite the publishing ministry.
setup: Search data.gov.in for "State/UT-wise number of ITIs", open the dataset, copy its resource ID (the long code in the API tab) into OGD_RESOURCE_ITI_STATEWISE.

name: Any other data.gov.in dataset
what: A slot for one more Open Government Data resource, such as apprenticeship or employment-exchange tables.
setup: Copy a resource ID from data.gov.in into OGD_RESOURCE_CUSTOM.

name: Job vacancies on National Career Service
what: Vacancies posted by employers, by location and trade. The best official source for Sector 62 and 63 jobs.
terms: No open API found. Needs a data-sharing request to the Directorate General of Employment.

name: ITI pass-outs by trade
what: Trainees passing out of ITIs in Gautam Buddh Nagar, by trade. Needed for the jobs-per-pass-out figure.
portal: NCVT MIS / Skill India Digital Hub
terms: No open API found. Needs approval from DGT or the state directorate (data-sharing agreement).

name: Informal worker registrations
what: e-Shram registrations by district and occupation.
terms: No open API found. Aggregate figures need a request to the ministry.
